verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is indirect. It shows Cloud Run exists as a first-party target for deploying apps, referenced through its official MCP server docs and the cloud-run-mcp repo, but nothing describes it as serverless or documents its behavior. missing for 10: explicit evidence of serverless functions/containers, documented trigger types (HTTP, Pub/Sub, events), documented quotas and limits, documented cold-start behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.
